head: 2918e93

rows.evidence: java.lang.AssertionError: status (errors: <- com.snoworca.naruserve.proxy.ProxyException <- javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: (certificate_unknown) NotAfter: Mon Jan 03 20:08:10 KST 2000 <- java.security.cert.CertificateExpiredException: NotAfter: Mon Jan 03 20:08:10 KST 2000) expected:<200> but was:<502> (JDK 17; the platform X509TrustManager alone ACCEPTS the same chain [leaf, intermediate-by-expired-root, intermediate-by-valid-CA] with the same two anchors, verified by a direct checkServerTrusted probe)

rows.note: Probe: bundle {expired root R1, valid CA R2}, presented [leaf, R2 cert, I_byR1] to make the walk stop at a given cert before reaching I_byR1. Green on JDK: the platform PKIX builder (unordered chain -> doBuild) filters trust anchors by validity date and rejects ('unable to find valid certification path'). Not testable on Android Conscrypt here.
Same as LP-2 with the X509Certificate overload.
Control: expired given root reached through a presented intermediate in order [leaf, I_byR1] gives 502 CONNECT_FAILED (walk throws CertificateExpiredException).
Control for LP-1: [leaf, I_byR2] with bundle {expired R1, valid R2} is reached.

PEM strictness: PEM header lines inside a block, form feed, '=' in the middle, a valid block followed by a BEGIN without END, two DER certificates in one block, empty block, and a short non-certificate DER all throw IllegalArgumentException.

reviewed_without_finding: Static review: no fallback to system CAs (empty KeyStore + TMF), delegate exceptions propagate, signed() only narrows the issuer set; host name check unchanged (TlsConnector + reflective endpoint id; JDK wraps non-extended TM in AbstractTrustManagerWrapper); NPE/IAE at the call; array cloned; later of sslSocketFactory/trustCertificates wins via withSslSocketFactory; no java.util.Base64 / X509ExtendedTrustManager in main; docs carry both overloads, Express ca, Java/Kotlin examples, only-given-trusted, SAN rule, openssl command; OPS-DX-010 AC-2 table rows present; IR-PROXY-001 AC-3/AC-5 covered by ProxyApiTest and derived().
